purpose: Reference emission factors for a carbon footprint calculator scoped to Ernakulam district, Kerala, India. This database intentionally separates district-scoped assumptions from national grid/default factors and does not claim district-specific validity where the source is national or generic.

geographic_scope.scope_note: Ernakulam district is the planning area. National default factors are retained only when the source explicitly states a national or grid-level applicability and are clearly labelled as not district-specific.

factors.activity: purchased electricity consumption from the India grid
factors.geographic_applicability: India (national grid, location-based electricity factor); not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.source_organisation: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power, Government of India
factors.source_document: CEA CO2 Baseline Database and associated user guidance for the national grid baseline; official CEA database for FY 2025-26.
factors.methodology: Location-based electricity grid emission factor from the official CEA CO2 Baseline Database. This is the national grid factor and should not be confused with operating margin, build margin or combined margin values.
factors.assumptions: Used for purchased power from the Indian grid when a district-specific supplier factor is unavailable. This factor is not a district-specific Ernakulam utility emissions factor and should not be treated as a local grid factor.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: National grid factor; not site-specific; not applicable to captive generation, rooftop solar or contractual renewable procurement claims; year-specific review is required for each reporting period.

factors.geographic_applicability: Internationally documented combustion default; applicable as a generic fuel factor where no local fuel-spec factor is available; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: Methodology default; not tied to a single fiscal year.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 emission factor for petrol/gasoline combustion from IPCC energy-sector methodologies; excludes CH4 and N2O unless separately calculated.
factors.assumptions: Conventional petrol fuel; standard fuel quality assumptions; no facility-specific combustion efficiency adjustment; direct CO2 only.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic fuel factor; actual emissions vary by blend, fuel composition and vehicle or combustion equipment performance; not a facility-specific measurement.

factors.geographic_applicability: Internationally documented combustion default; applicable as a generic fuel factor where no local fuel-spec factor is available; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: Methodology default; not tied to a single fiscal year.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 emission factor for diesel combustion from IPCC energy-sector methodologies; excludes CH4 and N2O unless separately calculated.
factors.assumptions: Conventional diesel fuel; standard fuel carbon content and oxidation assumptions; no facility-specific boiler or engine efficiency adjustment.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic fuel factor; actual emissions vary by fuel properties and combustion technology; not a facility-specific or stack-measurement factor.

factors.geographic_applicability: Internationally documented combustion default; applicable as a generic fuel factor where no local fuel-spec factor is available; not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: Methodology default; not tied to a single fiscal year.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 emission factor for LPG combustion from IPCC energy-sector methodologies; excludes CH4 and N2O unless separately calculated.
factors.assumptions: Conventional liquefied petroleum gas; standard carbon content and oxidation assumptions; no household appliance or industrial equipment adjustment.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic combustion factor; actual emissions depend on appliance efficiency and composition; not a district-specific or technology-specific factor.

factors.activity: direct combustion of diesel in industrial boilers, generators and stationary equipment
factors.geographic_applicability: General fossil-fuel combustion default; not facility-specific and not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: Methodology default; not tied to a single fiscal year.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 emission factor for fossil fuel combustion in stationary industrial equipment; separate from purchased grid electricity emissions. CH4 and N2O are not included in this coefficient.
factors.assumptions: Applies to diesel consumed directly in stationary industrial combustion; no process-specific technology adjustment; no capture or abatement assumptions.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: This is a generic combustion factor, not a measured stack-emission factor; it does not cover electricity consumed or upstream fuel production emissions.

factors.activity: direct combustion of LPG in industrial and process heating equipment
factors.geographic_applicability: General fossil-fuel combustion default; not facility-specific and not Ernakulam-specific.
factors.reporting_year: Methodology default; not tied to a single fiscal year.
factors.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy.
factors.methodology: Direct CO2 emission factor for LPG combustion in stationary industrial use; separate from purchased electricity emissions. CH4 and N2O are not included in this coefficient.
factors.assumptions: Applies to LPG consumed directly in combustion equipment; no process-specific or burner-efficiency adjustment.
factors.uncertainty_or_limitations: Generic combustion factor; not a measured stack-emission factor; not representative of all industrial combustion technologies or fuel blends.
